picks.title: ‘AI 활용 원고’ 신춘문예선 안받습니다[소소한 복도통신]
picks.excerpt: 생성형 AI로 쓴 'AI 원고'가 신춘문예 응모작에 쏟아지면서 일간지 신춘문예 담당 기자들이 AI 활용 원고를 받지 않겠다고 공지하고 심사위원들에게 미리 양해를 구하는 상황을 전한다.
picks.rationale: New submission rule: Korean dailies' 신춘문예 contests now publicly refuse AI-assisted manuscripts — directly changes what aspiring writers can submit this season.

picks.title: SelfPubCon26 highlights: 7 ideas from the 2026 Self-Publishing Advice Conference
picks.excerpt: ALLi's SelfPubCon26 takeaways for indie authors include optimizing to be found when readers ask AI assistants for book recommendations, and a publisher who runs admin across eight brands with AI agents while keeping all writing and editing human.
picks.rationale: Most actionable item in the pool: concrete practices from SelfPubCon26 for indie authors (AI-assistant discoverability, AI agents for admin with human-only writing).

picks.title: AI Is Destroying the Trust Between Writers and Readers
picks.excerpt: Novelist Rachel Kadish describes ChatGPT inventing a false plotline for her novel The Weight of Ink that a reader then confronted her about, and argues AI literary scams and fabrications are eroding trust between authors and readers.
picks.rationale: Fresh first-hand case: ChatGPT fabricating a plot for a real novel and a reader confronting the author — a new angle (AI hallucinations about existing books) not covered by prior slop/scam cards.

picks.title: Wee Tian Beng's The Celestial Zone Is Getting an AI-Assisted Anime From 2027
picks.excerpt: New Singapore company XM Media launched at Game Fest 2026 with plans to turn Wee Tian Beng's 1999 wuxia comic The Celestial Zone into a multi-season anime from 2027 using AI-assisted animation.
picks.rationale: New announcement: a classic Singapore comic gets a multi-season AI-assisted anime adaptation — comics-to-screen via AI outside Korea/Japan.

picks.title: TN suspends five library officials over procurement of AI-generated books
picks.excerpt: Tamil Nadu govt suspends five library officials over procurement of AI-generated books for Periyar Arivulagam Library, Coimbatore; DVAC inquiry underway.
picks.rationale: Follow-up with a new concrete action: Tamil Nadu suspends five library officials and opens a DVAC inquiry over AI-generated book purchases — consequences beyond the 11-07 probe and 11-11 court FIR order.

https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city.new_action: Tamil Nadu government suspended five library officials and a DVAC (vigilance) inquiry is underway — new disciplinary action after the 11-07 probe order and the 11-11 Madras HC FIR order (barandbench).
